The two-vector deep copy is already minimal, so I kept the initializer-list form (constructing each vector directly at its final size) rather than a default-construct-then-assign body, which would add extra work; no manual reserve/push_back loop can beat the vector copy constructor here.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
